Specialization.Name: Scoundrel (reSpecialized) 1.2
Specialization.Description: [H4]Scoundrel (reSpecialized)[h4] [B]SCOUNDREL—TALK YOURSELF IN AND OUT OF TROUBLE[b][BR] [B]At a Glance[b][BR] The scoundrel is the quick-witted conman, borrowing from Chewie to pay Han. Always working a deal, abandoning it in a flash when it all goes south. Often utilising deception as a means (although maybe not always successfully). When the chips are down, will scrap for their freedom.[BR] [B]All-in or Hybrid?[b][BR] ½ Deception focused 1/4 Ranged Light combatant (single weapon only), 1/4 Cool/Initiative[BR] [B]What Should it be the Best At?[b][BR] Deceiving and con jobs.[BR] Getting out of trouble.[BR] [B]What should it be just “good” at?[b][BR] Single pistol Ranged Light weapons.[BR] [B]Specs for Comparison / Inspiration[b][BR] [I]Gunslinger[i](The Scoundrel is very much a watered down and catch all spec for most of what the other more specialized specs do for Smuggler)[BR] [I]Thief[i](Barely any overlap, aside from incidental caring about Deception)[BR] [I]Charmer[i](Less so part of the Scoundrels repertoire but there should be a small element of charm to the scruffy looking nerf-herder)[BR] [I]Death Watch Warrior[i](Less focused on movement, but they will have a similar emphasis on death-dealing)[BR] [I]Pirate[i](The pirate is the Scoundrel who has an entire crew at their disposal to pillage what they desire, although more overt than the scoundrel)[BR] [I]Performer[i](Some distraction and deception elements)[BR] [B]Media Touchstones[b][BR] Han Solo[BR] Jod Na Nawood (Skeleton Crew)[BR] Malcolm Reynolds (Firefly)[BR] Jack Sparrow (Pirates of the Caribbean)[BR] Eddy (Ed, Edd, & Eddy)[BR] Updated 12/10/2025
